content.text: {"methodology":"Inspected the catalog and aggregate training summaries for all nine components, then ran the required current baselines for daily components and first-listed curve baselines for quote_multiplier and conversion. I used the remaining validation budget for targeted alternatives rather than a broad grid: rolling means for noisy/sparse rates, regularized ridge and conservative xgboost lag/calendar models for autocorrelated count/rate series, and all bounded curve alternatives for the two curve components. I reviewed fold stability, weekday bias, and horizon-error profiles for the selected candidates before freezing. Final frozen selections: aog_rate = trial 56ac35d5ec53c862, rolling_mean, selected because it improved over current validation RMSE and had small fold biases; smx_rate = trial 53d3a3bb659369b3, current, because the ridge alternative was materially worse and folds were stable; umx_rate = trial 29869b08f3298c07, conservative xgboost, because it gave the best tried score and reduced the current model’s positive bias; cna_rate = trial 7d868af822a19c76, rolling_mean, because it improved score and reduced overfitting risk for a sparse low-rate series; program_live_legs = trial 70d179cf8fb622df, current, because ridge and seasonal-naive alternatives had higher validation errors; non_program_live_legs = trial 3c8923f8997fa213, conservative xgboost, because it clearly improved validation score and underbias versus current/ridge; daily_quote_count = trial 76fcc8891c4b76f9, current, because boosted and ridge alternatives underforecasted later folds and scored worse; quote_multiplier = trial be4b87776c33dee9, shrink_half curve, because it was best among current_lowess, constant_one, and shrink_half; conversion = trial e034a30989a32294, isotonic curve, because it slightly improved log loss/Brier over current_exponential and beat the constant curve.","caveats":["Selections are based only on the fixed retrospective validation origins supplied by the tool: 2025-06-30, 2025-08-31, and 2025-09-30, with a 28-day daily horizon where applicable.","I did not exhaustively search hyperparameters; the process was intentionally lean to control API cost and reserve budget across all nine components.","Some selected models retain meaningful residual bias: notably program_live_legs and daily_quote_count, where current models still outperformed tried alternatives despite bias patterns.","The conversion improvement from isotonic over current_exponential was small, so that choice has limited margin of evidence.","Curve labels are observational and these choices should not be interpreted causally or as revenue optimization decisions.","No claim of universal optimality is made; the frozen pipeline is the best supported among the evaluated recipes under the provided validation evidence."]}
